public_rationale: Meta's announcement supports a substantial increase in LLM training scale. Its V-JEPA program shows other research, but that alone does not disprove mostly. xAI's multimodal announcement also complicates the characterization without establishing a separate approach or successive size increases. The available records do not settle xAI's exclusivity or Meta's predominance.
limitations: Public announcements do not provide a complete account of internal research.
The existence of an alternative project does not establish its share of total effort.
A literal parameter-only reading would differ from the broader scaling reading used here.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Musk's xAI is just building bigger LLMs, and Meta is mostly doing the same.

statement.excerpt: Musk is just building bigger and bigger LLMs, and Meta is mostly (despite LeCun’s reservations) mostly doing the same.

from_speaker: Musk is just building bigger and bigger LLMs
our_interpretation: Musk refers here to xAI's substantive AI development, not his other companies.
The ordinary reading is that xAI's approach is confined to scaling LLMs, while scaling LLMs dominates Meta's approach.
Bigger includes model and training scale. It does not require every released model to have more parameters than its predecessor.
Because the sentence describes an ongoing development trend, I use the current calendar year through the post, January 1–May 29, 2024. The starting boundary is an evaluator choice.
An alternative Meta research program does not by itself contradict mostly. Announcements alone do not measure the distribution of research effort.
criteria.support_condition: Contemporary development records establish successive increases in LLM scale as xAI's exclusive substantive approach and Meta's predominant substantive approach.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Records establish a substantial xAI approach beyond scaling LLMs, or establish that scaling LLMs was not Meta's predominant approach. A multimodal extension alone is insufficient unless its development establishes more than scaling the same underlying approach.

evidence.explanation: Meta directly documents increased LLM training scale. This supports the scaling component, but does not establish that scaling comprised most of its AI development.

evidence.locator: Video JEPA in focus, first paragraph
evidence.explanation: Meta was pursuing an approach distinct from enlarging language models. This limits an exclusive characterization of Meta, but does not contradict Marcus's qualified word mostly.

xAI announced multimodal development, which complicates the description of merely making text models larger. The announcement does not establish that this work departed from scaling an LLM-based approach.
